title: Merchandising
section: The Merchandising Art of Star Wars
description: Merchandising the STAR WARS trilogy was an art by itself. Kenner Products held the worldwide toy license. This 1984 collage (front) from Cato Yasumura Behaeghel studio uas for a vinyl collectors case that never actually carried the "Power of the Force" logo. The 1982 EMPIRE collage (back) is from Index Design Associates. (Collection of Thomas H. Neiheisel.)
